query:
WITH dd AS (
                SELECT userid, channelid, rootid
                  FROM drafts
                 WHERE createat > $1 OR (createat = $1 AND userid > $2)
                 ORDER BY createat, userid
                 LIMIT 100
            )
            DELETE FROM drafts d
             USING dd
             WHERE d.userid = dd.userid
               AND d.channelid = dd.channelid
               AND d.rootid = dd.rootid
               AND d.message = ''
